main.description: Upload an image to the authenticated user's repository. The AppView strips metadata (including EXIF location), applies EXIF orientation, and stores the sanitized bytes as a blob on the user's PDS. Requires an OAuth session granted the blob:*/* scope, or an aggregator API key or service JWT whose aggregator has a stored OAuth session granted that scope.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the stored bytes, detected from the image rather than the request's Content-Type. An oriented WebP is stored as JPEG or PNG.

aspectRatio.description: Width and height of the stored image after orientation

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: The request carries no credentials, a malformed Authorization header, or a token or session this AppView does not recognise or no longer holds; sign in

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request's session was accepted by this AppView, but the user's PDS rejected it as expired or revoked; sign in again

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request body could not be read

errors.name: RequestTimeout
errors.description: The request body was not received in time; try again

errors.name: MissingBlobScope
errors.description: The session was not granted the blob:*/* scope; sign in again to grant it

errors.name: ImageTooLarge
errors.description: The request body, or the sanitized image, exceeds 10,000,000 bytes

errors.name: UnsupportedImageFormat
errors.description: The image is not JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF

errors.name: ImageDimensionsTooLarge
errors.description: The image has more than 50,000,000 pixels

errors.name: InvalidImage
errors.description: The image could not be decoded

errors.name: UploadRateLimited
errors.description: The user has stored as many uploads as this AppView allows in a rolling ten-minute window; try again later

errors.name: PDSUploadFailed
errors.description: The user's PDS could not be reached, failed, or did not store the blob

errors.name: PayloadTooLarge
errors.description: The user's PDS refused the sanitized image as larger than its own blob limit

errors.name: PermissionDenied
errors.description: The user's PDS refused the upload for this session's permissions; sign in again to grant them

errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: The user's PDS rate-limited the upload; try again later

errors.name: SessionBusy
errors.description: Another request is refreshing this session; retry

errors.name: ServiceUnavailable
errors.description: Image processing is busy, or an aggregator's stored session could not be loaded or resumed; try again

errors.name: NoAuthorCredentials
errors.description: The aggregator authenticated by API key or service JWT has no usable stored OAuth session; it must complete the OAuth flow again

errors.name: Timeout
errors.description: The upload did not complete in time

errors.name: RequestCanceled
errors.description: The request was canceled before the upload completed
